subject: Control System
questionText:
The feedback system with characteristic equation,
s4 + 20ks3 + 5s2 + 10s +15 = 0 is
(a)
Stable for all values of K
(b) Stable for positive value of K
(c)
Stable for ∞ > K > 70
(d) Unstable for all values of K
MCQ 
EASY

options.text: Stable for all values of K
Stable for positive value of K
Unstable for all values of K

explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-10 (Routh Hurwitz Criteria -(Part-03 & 04)).
